title: TwistMyCraft
description: A challenge mod with optional streamer integrations. It rolls random gameplay challenges on a timer, shows an in-game overlay, and can display Twitch and YouTube chat with optional viewer-triggered commands
body:
![TwistMyCraft title](https://utils.notionsmp.org/pph/?text=%20%20twistmycraft%20%20&color=0xD03E53&size=20)
---

A Fabric mod that adds a rotating challenge system for Minecraft, plus optional streamer features including chat overlay and viewer commands.

## ✨ Features
- **Dynamic Challenge Timer**: Challenges automatically rotate on an interval controlled by the `challengeInterval` gamerule
- **30+ Unique Challenges**: Mix of gameplay twists and visual effects including shaders and post-processing
- **In-Game HUD Overlay**: Shows active challenges and timing information
- **Streamer Chat Integration**: Display Twitch and YouTube chat messages directly in-game
- **Viewer Commands**: Allow chat commands to trigger in-game effects (optional)

## 📋 Commands & Controls

### Gamerule
- `challengeInterval` - Set challenge rotation interval in seconds

### Server Commands (`/tmc`)
- `/tmc start`, `/tmc stop`, `/tmc pause`, `/tmc resume` - Challenge system controls
- `/tmc challenge <challenge_id|random>` - Manually trigger a specific challenge

## ⚙️ Configuration

### Client Config (`config/twistmycraft_client.json`)
- Controls which Twitch/YouTube sources appear in chat overlay
- **Commands** toggle (singleplayer) controls viewer command permissions

### Server Config (`config/twistmycraft_server.json`)
- `enableStreamerMode` - Gates viewer commands entirely
- `commandSources` - Lists which chat sources can run viewer commands

## 🎮 How to Access Settings
Open the **Streamer** button from the Minecraft options menu. If using ModMenu, TwistMyCraft also registers a ModMenu config screen (ModMenu optional).
